note: Filed under GameFAQs' 'PlayStation DexDrive Save (Europe)' section, but it is not a DexDrive .gme: one raw 8192-byte save block, served as .gme: the 'SC' title frame reads 'FF7/SAVE01/99:00' (a Final Fantasy VII save), but there is no directory frame, so no save name. The block carries no directory name; following MemcardRex the converter names the save after the file (its first 20 bytes, 'final-fantasy-vii.34'), which no game looks for. The release is taken from the section (Europe) and the title frame; a PAL save would be named BESCES-00867FF7-S01..S15. one-saves (1saves convert) does not read this file: a PS1 memory card is 131072 bytes, or that behind a DexDrive, VGS or PSP header, but this file is 8192 bytes
